reviews.title: Superb design and quality
reviews.comment: This is a beautiful case in all white.  The is more than enough room for just about anything you want to put in there.  Even with a vertically mounted 5070 ti, there is a lot of extra space left over, giving the final result a nice open feel.  That said, it's a large case - make sure you have room for it at close to 13" deep.  There a several things that made this the easiest build I have done.  Aside from the interior size, the dual chambered design makes cabling easy and keeps the front side clean-looking.  Additionally, every bracket, screw hole and snap connection matched up perfectly with overall fit and finish being near-perfect.  I have six intake fans and four exhaust fans, including the AIO cooler for plenty of airflow, though on the down side, the slatted exterior covers probably restrict the airflow to some extent.  One other concern is that it will be a tight fit to get even one low-profile pci card in along with the gpu and pci riser.  Not an issue right now, but possibly in the future.  The case does not come with any fans, though given the range of fan choices and options, included fans probably be not what the user wants anyway.  The case is not inexpensive, but I think worth the cost.  It is heavy also, but built very sturdily.
reviews.author: EricAZ

reviews.title: Love this case!
reviews.comment: I adore this case! Yes, it's definitely a luxury case as it's pricier than others, but this version does have the 2k screen included. The glass is tempered and I didn't have any issues with it cracking or scratching during the pc build. The bottom compartment does fit three fans, just know you need to fit one inside the case before attaching it to the bracket to make them all fit. As far as the screen goes, it's a beautiful screen, do note, you need to connect it directly to the motherboard for the picture to work and download the software so you can set your picture/widgets. The cables to hook it up are already ran to the back of the case when it arrives, so you'll just need to hook them up to your motherboard and power supply. The top of the case does have a compartment that lowers if you want to mount fans or your AIO closer to your motherboard. Do note, this case includes a PCIe riser 4.0 to connect your GPU to your MOB so the GPU sits upright in the case. IF you need a 5.0 connection like I did, you'll need to purchase the 5.0 riser off Hyte's website, at the time I purchased, they were $99 and you can choose which color you'd like. The case has plenty of places to route your cables for easy cable management as well as preinstalled Velcro in the bottom to hold some of the cables. The only downside I saw was needing to buy an updated PCIe riser, I wish they would have had that as an upgrade option at purchase, as well as there being two open spots on the back of the side where you mount the GPU etc. I'm assuming its for easier access, but I do worry about the amount of dust etc that allows into the pc, though I'm sure it's great for airflow.
reviews.author: Amazon_Customer

reviews.title: Premium Case with a Built-In Touchscreen – Still One of the Best After 2 Years
reviews.comment: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ – One of the Best Cases I’ve Ever Built In I’ve had the HYTE Y70 Touch Infinite Dual Chamber ATX Case for about two years now, and honestly, it’s one of the best PC cases I’ve ever built in. First off, the build experience is incredibly smooth. The dual-chamber design gives you tons of room to work with, making cable management clean and stress-free. Everything feels thoughtfully laid out, so even more complex builds come together easily without feeling cramped. Compatibility and size are a huge plus. This case easily supports larger GPUs, multiple radiators, and high-end components without any issues. Whether you’re running a high-performance gaming setup or a workstation build, there’s more than enough space to work with. One of the standout features is the built-in touchscreen, which is honestly amazing. It adds a completely different level of customization and functionality—you can display system stats, animations, or anything you want. It’s not just a gimmick, it actually enhances the overall experience and makes the build feel premium. Installation overall is very straightforward. Panels come off easily, parts line up well, and the modular design helps speed things up. It’s clear this case was designed with builders in mind. Price-wise, it’s definitely on the higher end, but after using it for two years, I can say it’s absolutely worth it. The quality, features, and overall experience justify the investment. Pros: • Extremely easy and enjoyable to build in • Spacious with excellent compatibility for high-end parts • Dual-chamber design keeps everything clean and organized • Built-in touchscreen is a standout feature and works great • Premium look and feel Cons: • Higher price point, but you get what you pay for Overall, if you’re looking for a high-end case that combines performance, aesthetics, and innovation, this is a top-tier choice.
reviews.author: Aaron medina

reviews.title: Great case
reviews.comment: Show-stopping touchscreen display adds flair and functionality most cases don’t offer. Massive internal space & cooling support, great for custom water-cooling builds. the app was slow, memory-hungry, and occasionally forgetful, making the touchscreen experience less smooth than anticipated. If you want something that stands out visually and adds a new layer of interactivity to your setup, it’s one of the few cases that delivers on that promise. The hardware design and cooling support are excellent for high-end builds. However, if you prefer a straightforward, no-nonsense build or care more about pure performance than showmanship, you might find the touchscreen feature a bit gimmicky, especially given the bumpy software experience. This isn’t just a gimmick — it can display real system information and interact with apps — but the software side still needs polishing and can be heavy on RAM or laggy with more complex widgets. The HYTE Y70 Touch is a premium ATX mid-tower PC case that stands out primarily for its large integrated touchscreen, along with a spacious dual-chamber interior and strong cooling potential. It’s designed for high-end systems where aesthetics, display integration, and build showcase are as important as performance.
reviews.author: Savana

reviews.title: The perfect pc case!
reviews.comment: This has been my dream case for the longest time now! I finally did a big pc upgrade and I was super excited to make a hyte build. I thought the glass panels and regular panels would be hard to remove from the case but it's super easy to pop off ( and I have long nails ). The case is a lot bigger than what I thought it would be but I love how spacious it is, it makes it super easy to build your pc in. I was also surprised to see it had a section at the bottom of the case for fans so I might add some down there later on. The case filters out dust well and makes it super easy to clean when dust builds up in the filters. Like I said before it's so easy to remove the case panels cleaning your pc is not a chore, you can easily pop out the panels making removability easy. I definitely think it's worth the money, I'm so in love with the touch panel I use it mainly for discord and Spotify and I just love how the case looks! And because it's so big air flow is great and the pc itself is very quiet.
